Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static List<String> dependencyReady(List<List<String>> items, Set<String> completed)
Behavior: Each item is name followed by zero or more dependency names. Names match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Reject duplicate names, unknown dependencies, and cycles. Return code-point-lexicographically sorted names whose dependencies are all completed, excluding completed items.
Visible example: items api->db, db, ui->api with completed [db] returns [api].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
